Automations without the learning curve
Routine runs 100% locally on your device. No accounts, no cloud sync, no external companion apps, and zero analytics.
One-tap templates with clear Ready, Setup, and Privileged badges.
Encrypted local SQLite rule and execution log storage.
Built-in safety circuit breaker after 5 consecutive failures.
Reliable background execution
Grant notifications for alerts and exempt Routine from aggressive battery killing so scheduled rules fire on time.
Review Notification Permission
Review Battery Optimization
Granted
Three self-contained capability tiers
Most automations work out of the box. Power-user toggles (Wi-Fi, Hotspot, Night Light) can be unlocked anytime in Settings with zero third-party apps.
1. Standard Tier (Ready Now)
Time, battery, charger, Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb, brightness, notifications, and app launches.
2. One-Time ADB Grant (Persistent)
Run one adb command once to unlock Settings.Secure toggles across reboots with no background daemon.
3. Built-in Wireless ADB Bridge
Pair directly via Android 11+ Wireless Debugging inside Routine for full shell-level Wi-Fi and hotspot toggles.
Why Routine needs this

Post Notifications
Allows Routine to deliver reminder notifications, storage/data alerts, and circuit-breaker warnings.
Notification actions will be skipped while toast, ringer, and setting rules continue to work.
Alarms & Reminders
Fires time-based automations (such as Bedtime Mode and Morning Briefing) at the exact minute you choose.
Routine falls back to Android\'s inexact idle-friendly alarm window.
Unrestricted Battery Usage
Prevents OEM battery savers from delaying exact time triggers or stopping Wireless Debugging reconnection.
Rules still run through standard Android broadcasts and WorkManager, which may be deferred during Doze.
Do Not Disturb Access
Required by Android to silence the ringer or enable Do Not Disturb during meetings and bedtime.
Ringer can still switch between Normal and Vibrate, and notifications still work.
Modify System Settings
Lets Routine adjust screen brightness percentage and lock screen auto-rotation.
Brightness and rotation-lock steps will report Needs Setup until enabled.
Location Access for Wi-Fi & Geofences
Android requires location permission to read the connected Wi-Fi SSID name or detect arrival at a saved place.
Time, charger, battery, and manual triggers remain available without location.
Nearby Bluetooth Devices
Detects when your car hands-free kit or Bluetooth headphones connect.
Bluetooth-triggered rules stay paused until permission is granted.
Read Calendar Busy Status
Checks whether a busy calendar event is currently in progress to toggle Do Not Disturb automatically.
You can switch the rule to Manual trigger mode without calendar access.
Contacts & Call Screening
Checks whether an incoming caller is in your address book so unknown spam callers can be silenced locally.
Incoming calls will ring normally.
Usage Access
Reads monthly mobile data usage totals to alert you before exceeding your carrier cap.
Storage alerts and other periodic checks continue working without Usage Access.
Send SMS Auto-Reply
Allows optional direct SMS auto-reply when connected to your car Bluetooth.
Routine falls back to opening your SMS app with the reply pre-filled.
Optional Foreground App Detector
Observes window package changes only so Routine knows when a configured video or reading app opens. Never reads screen text or taps UI.
All other 18 templates work without enabling Accessibility.
Self-Contained Privileged Tier
Android restricts Wi-Fi, Hotspot, and Settings.Secure toggles to shell or WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS privileges.
Routine opens the Quick Settings Wi-Fi panel or guides you through built-in Wireless Debugging / One-Time ADB setup.
